summary: Skill Tree feature (100-level kids quiz) tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (100%) covering GET /api/kids/level/{1,50,95,0,101}, tier composition, determinism, progress fresh device, complete-level flow (pass/fail, no regression on current_level, max-wins on stars), no _id leaks, and regression suite (/api/prophets chrono=25, /api/prophets/musa detail, /api/quran/surahs=114, /api/tts/generate). Frontend: kids tab renders 'قسم الأطفال' header with 3 stats (current level=1, stars=0, completed=0), both subtabs 'المراحل' + 'قصص للأطفال' present with tree default. tree-node-1 shows 'أنت هنا' badge and is tappable → navigates to /kids/level/1 showing 'المرحلة 1' header, progress bar, and 4 quiz options. Locked tree-node-5 is aria-disabled=true and does NOT navigate on tap (stayed on /kids). Stories subtab shows 25 prophet cards. Minor React Native warnings surfaced (see react_native_issues) but do not block functionality.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on RN Web / new architecture. Use 'boxShadow' or Platform.select. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/kids.tsx:68-70 (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset).

Console shows 'Font load fallback NetworkError' and multiple 404s on font assets during Expo web preview. Pre-existing (also seen in iteration_1 context) but should be verified — check assets/fonts wiring in app/_layout.tsx.

action_items: (Optional/Minor) Replace deprecated shadow* style props in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/kids.tsx (nodeAvailable) with the new boxShadow prop or Platform.select to silence RN Web warnings.
(Optional) Investigate the recurring 404s on font resources during web preview — likely a missing font in the web bundle; does not block UI but pollutes console.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_progress and complete_level correctly project out _id via {'_id': 0} — no ObjectId leak.
complete_level correctly enforces max-wins on stars (max(prev_stars, stars)) and non-regressing current_level (only advances when passed AND payload.level >= current_level).
skill_tree.questions_for_level is deterministic (rng seeded from 1000+level) and tier composition matches spec: easy (≤33), mixed easy/medium (34-66), medium/hard (67-100). Verified by tests.
server.py at 428 lines — well under 700-line threshold.
Frontend kids.tsx uses testID on all interactive nodes (tree-node-{n}, kids-tab-tree/stories, kids-story-*) — good testability.
Level quiz screen properly gates navigation on `disabled={state === 'locked'}` — confirmed via UI test (node-5 tap kept URL on /kids).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 UI flows in review request verified)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: each test class uses TEST_-prefixed random device_id (uuid4 suffix). No production data touched. MongoDB kids_progress collection accumulates a few TEST_progress_* docs; safe to leave or purge with db.kids_progress.deleteMany({device_id: /^TEST_/}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run all backend tests: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Skill tree suite is in test_skill_tree.py (17 tests) and prophets/TTS regression in test_prophets_api.py (18 tests). Frontend kids flow: open the app root, tap the Arabic label 'الأطفال' in bottom tab (no dedicated data-testid on that tab wrapper). Use testIDs kids-tab-tree, kids-tab-stories, tree-node-{n}, quiz-option-{0..3}, quiz-next, level-back, level-quit, result-retry, result-next-level, result-tree, kids-story-{prophet_id}. Locked nodes render with aria-disabled=true — clicking is a no-op.
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs found. All spec items 1-15 in the review request were verified and pass.
